text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oooh! They've got so much fun stuff<n>here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This frog toy feels all slimy! It's just<n>like the real
thing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And this pen zaps you when ya touch<n>it! Oh, and
this ghost mask seems<n>great for scarin' people!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... It's so hard to choose...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's only one way to solve this<n>problem—buy
'em all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! With all these tools, I'm<n>gonna prank
the entire academy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, though... Feels like I'm<n>forgettin'
something...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I bought all the stuff I wanted...<n>Buuut...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Meh, whatever! It's time to get<n>prankin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Preoccupied with setting up pranks all<n>over the
academy, Shinko Windy<n>completely forgets about
her training.
